name: Fuutou Shizune
source:
A third-year student. The second daughter of the head of the Fuutou School of Ikebana. A true-blue young lady.

She is refined and intelligent, with a demure and gentle demeanor. She has a kind nature and rarely gets angry, but when she does, she is actually quite terrifying.

She serves as the president of the student council and is in a rivalry with Rin, who completely disregards the academy’s rules.

She and Kazuto are childhood friends. Kazuto calls her “Big Sis.” She is worried about the current situation where Kazuto is doing whatever Rin tells him to do.

Eventually, out of sheer concern, she follows Kazuto and barges into the Western-style mansion where Rin is waiting.

As “Big Sis,” she has a very strong desire to protect Kazuto. She is a virgin.

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/oshioki/char04.html]official site[/url]]
